title: Decide whether a CLIP bundle can enter canary
description: Choose the product decision, candidate bundle, and evidence policy. Quality gains cannot override a broken processor, tokenizer, index, protected slice, or rollback contract.

useCases.label: Catalog retrieval
useCases.detail: Text queries search a precomputed image-vector index.
useCases.artifactRequirement: The catalog index must be built with the candidate image manifest.

useCases.label: Zero-shot classification
useCases.detail: Images are compared with an approved bank of class prompts.
useCases.artifactRequirement: The complete prompt bank must be evaluated and versioned.

policies.label: Balanced product gate
policies.detail: Allows a bounded canary when contracts are exact, protected slices are stable, and use-specific quality meets the current baseline.

policies.label: High-assurance gate
policies.detail: Requires stronger quality, calibration, slice, and latency evidence while preserving the same non-negotiable artifact checks.

candidates.label: Identical manifest repack
candidates.detail: The serving container changed; model, processors, prompts, and vector geometry did not.
candidates.operationalTruth: The semantic contract is unchanged. A canary still checks runtime packaging, capacity, and attribution.

candidates.label: Paired high-resolution model
candidates.detail: Checkpoint and processor were trained together at higher resolution, but the catalog index has not been rebuilt.
candidates.operationalTruth: Offline quality improved, but retrieval cannot mix the new text geometry with an index built from the previous image tower.

candidates.label: Untracked crop change
candidates.detail: The checkpoint is unchanged, while a library upgrade changed resize and crop behavior.
candidates.operationalTruth: Healthy average metrics do not approve unexplained preprocessing drift or the affected aspect-ratio slice.

candidates.label: Fast quantized towers
candidates.detail: The bundle is contract-compatible and fast, but the long-tail language slice regressed.
candidates.operationalTruth: Latency gains cannot offset a blocking protected-slice regression; tune quantization or narrow the supported path.
